description: The plot illustrates the relationship between a variable labeled 'M' and 'Perplexity' for three different models. The x-axis represents 'M', with a linear scale ranging from 3 to 7, in increments of 1. The y-axis represents 'Perplexity', with a linear scale ranging from 18 to 40, in increments of 2.  A blue line, marked with downward-pointing triangles, begins at approximately 33.3 at M=3 and decreases to approximately 31.8 at M=7. A green line, marked with circular points, begins at approximately 25.2 at M=3 and increases to approximately 28.8 at M=7. An orange line, marked with star shapes, begins at approximately 19.1 at M=3 and increases to approximately 19.8 at M=7.
